_about: Hand-written judgement for Decidim's work-in-motion map: each quote as Decidim's maintainers wrote it, with its source. Areas come later, from the Product Team's boards and the Metadecidim roadmap.
general_heading: From CONTRIBUTING.adoc and the contributor notes in .ai/

general.text: Do not open an issue on GitHub until you have collected positive feedback about the change and Product Team has approved it.
general.source: CONTRIBUTING.adoc, Do you intend to add a new feature or change an existing one?

general.text: When the PR includes a breaking change or includes something that requires manual intervention when deploying, it is necessary to add it on the changelog upgrade notes.
general.source: CONTRIBUTING.adoc, Did you write a patch that fixes a bug?

general.text: The locales are managed by Crowdin. When you are developing you must only take care of the en.yml files, do not change the other locales.
When creating new features that require database changes, migrations belong in the appropriate decidim-* module, not in the development app.

When making changes to decidim-generators that affect application configuration (files like config/application.rb, config/environments/*, etc) or other generated files, also document these changes in RELEASE_NOTES.md
